result.instructions: Tools for HaloPSA, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which open tickets does Acme have, and who is working on them?"; "Show the notes on ticket 1234 and add an internal note that the customer called back."; "Create a ticket for Acme's Berlin site: printer offline on the second floor.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes HaloPSA data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run halopsa_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run halopsa_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run halopsa_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. halopsa_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: halopsa_list_tickets
tools.title: List tickets
tools.description: List tickets (faults) in the HaloPSA tenant. Filter by text, client, site, agent, user, status, or open state. Halo API: GET /api/Tickets.

client_id.description: Only tickets of this client id.

site_id.description: Only tickets of this site id.

agent_id.description: Only tickets assigned to this agent id.

user_id.description: Only tickets raised by this end user id.

status_id.description: Only tickets in this status id (see halopsa_list_statuses).

open_only.description: Only tickets that are not closed.

tools.name: halopsa_get_ticket
tools.title: Get ticket
tools.description: Get one ticket by id, optionally with its details and its last action. Halo API: GET /api/Tickets/{id}.

include_last_action.description: Include the most recent note or action.

tools.name: halopsa_list_ticket_notes
tools.title: List ticket notes
tools.description: List the notes and actions on one ticket, oldest to newest. Halo API: GET /api/Actions?ticket_id=.

exclude_private.description: Leave out notes hidden from the customer.

tools.name: halopsa_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List clients (customers) in the HaloPSA tenant. Halo API: GET /api/Client.

tools.name: halopsa_get_client
tools.title: Get client
tools.description: Get one client by id, optionally with its details. Halo API: GET /api/Client/{id}.

tools.name: halopsa_list_sites
tools.title: List sites
tools.description: List sites (locations) of clients, optionally for one client. Halo API: GET /api/Site.

client_id.description: Only sites of this client id.

tools.name: halopsa_list_users
tools.title: List end users
tools.description: List end users (the customers' people who raise tickets), optionally for one client or site. Halo API: GET /api/Users.

client_id.description: Only users of this client id.

site_id.description: Only users of this site id.

tools.name: halopsa_list_agents
tools.title: List agents
tools.description: List agents (the tenant's technicians), optionally filtered by text or client. Halo API: GET /api/Agent.

client_id.description: Agents who can work for this client id.

tools.name: halopsa_list_assets
tools.title: List assets
tools.description: List assets (devices) in the tenant, optionally for one client, site or end user. Halo API: GET /api/Asset.

client_id.description: Only assets of this client id.

site_id.description: Only assets at this site id.

user_id.description: Only assets of this end user id.

tools.name: halopsa_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices, optionally for one client and a date range. Halo API: GET /api/Invoice.

client_id.description: Only invoices of this client id.

start_date.description: Start of the date range, as Halo expects it (e.g. 2026-01-31).

end_date.description: End of the date range, as Halo expects it (e.g. 2026-02-28).

tools.name: halopsa_list_statuses
tools.title: List ticket statuses
tools.description: List ticket statuses (with their ids), optionally for one ticket type. Use the ids in ticket filters and updates. Halo API: GET /api/Status.

tickettype_id.description: Only statuses used by this ticket type id.

ticket_id.description: Only statuses valid for this ticket id.

tools.name: halopsa_create_ticket
tools.title: Create ticket
tools.description: Create a ticket (fault) in the tenant. Only the summary is required. Customers may see the ticket. Halo API: POST /api/Tickets.

client_id.description: Client id the ticket belongs to.

site_id.description: Site id the ticket belongs to.

user_id.description: End user id who raised the ticket.

tickettype_id.description: Ticket type id (see Halo for the list).

agent_id.description: Agent id to assign the ticket to.

tools.name: halopsa_update_ticket
tools.title: Update ticket
tools.description: Change fields of one existing ticket. Only the fields you pass change. Use it to set status, priority or agent. Halo API: POST /api/Tickets with the ticket id.

agent_id.description: Agent id to assign the ticket to.

team_id.description: Team id to assign the ticket to.

tools.name: halopsa_add_ticket_note
tools.title: Add ticket note
tools.description: Add a note to one ticket. Set hidden_from_user to keep it internal. The tool does not ask Halo to send e-mail. Halo API: POST /api/Actions.

hidden_from_user.description: Keep the note hidden from the customer.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with HaloPSA
prompts.description: What you can do with HaloPSA here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_open_tickets_for_a_client
prompts.title: Check open tickets for a client
prompts.description: List the tickets, filtered by client, status or open state. Open one ticket and read its notes, oldest first.

prompts.name: look_up_a_client_s_sites_users_and_assets
prompts.title: Look up a client's sites, users and assets
prompts.description: List the clients and the sites of one client. List its end users and its assets.

prompts.name: open_a_ticket_for_a_customer
prompts.title: Open a ticket for a customer
prompts.description: Create a ticket with a summary. Customers may see the ticket, so check the text before you create it.

prompts.name: set_the_status_priority_or_agent_of_a_ticket
prompts.title: Set the status, priority or agent of a ticket
prompts.description: List the ticket statuses and the agents. Update one ticket to set its status, priority or agent.

prompts.name: add_an_internal_ticket_note
prompts.title: Add an internal ticket note
prompts.description: Add a note to one ticket. Set it as hidden from the user to keep it internal. The tool does not send e-mail.

prompts.name: review_invoices_for_a_client
prompts.title: Review invoices for a client
prompts.description: List the invoices of one client for a date range. List the clients to find the client id.
